name: First Screen Anchor Triplet
business_goal: turn the first post-banner screen into three clear purchase-decision anchors
viewer_question: 看完首图后，我最该先确认哪三件事？
layout_pattern: mobile-first stacked cards; each card has a colored left rail, 01/02/03 number, bold short title, and one concise support sentence
product_weight: 0%; this is a text/HTML decision module placed after banner and before deeper product proof images

text_zones.policy: buyer-facing decision label, max 8 Romanian words
one evidence-backed reason or usage outcome, max 1-2 lines on mobile

badge_zones.position: far left edge of each card
badge_zones.content: category-coded color rail; not a claim badge

scene_zones.role: banner or hero image that creates attention
product proof image, detail image, or feature band that expands the three anchors

color_style: white or near-white card, restrained accent rails, high contrast text, generous padding
prompt_keep_rules: Keep the component as a calm reading aid, not a decorative banner.
Each anchor must map to ProductTruthPack evidence or a planned proof module.
prompt_change_rules: Select the three anchors by product type: compatibility/control/safety for technical products; pain scene/portability/accessories for cleaning; comfort/safety/routine for beauty or baby; service/evidence/familiarity for brand trust.
Translate anchors into the listing target language after ProductTruthPack is finalized.
negative_constraints: Do not write internal SOP phrases such as 'specifications come after image' in customer-facing output.
Do not include unsupported warranty, delivery, seller rating, return, or platform claims.
Do not use more than three anchors or long paragraphs; the component must stay scannable on mobile.
text_policy: Deterministic HTML text only; do not render this text with an image model unless exporting the whole module as a board.
